versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Clean Air Room Planner.
- Calculates required HEPA CADR for a room based on size and desired air changes per hour.
- Checks if your purifier is adequate for your space and provides placement advice.
- Supports DIY box-fan (Corsi-Rosenthal) filter estimation.
- Includes a pollution diary for logging and analyzing indoor and outdoor PM2.5 levels.
- Tracks HEPA filter life using real usage hours and suggests replacement dates.
